# Anchor inventory

Every `Use when` clause across 27 installed plugins, 119 skills in all. Grep a candidate anchor here before shipping it: a collision means two skills answer one prompt, both load, and the winner depends on ordering. Rule: `ANCHOR-02`.

Regenerate with `python3 scripts/anchor_inventory.py`.

## Clauses by plugin

### contao

- **contao-backend**: Use when building a Contao backend module or route
- **contao-core**: Use when the request names Contao setup, a Contao bundle or the Manager plugin
- **contao-data**: Use when the request names a Contao DCA, tl_ table, Contao Model or migration
- **contao-frontend**: Use when building a Contao content element or frontend module
- **contao-manual-basics**: Use when asked how to operate or administer Contao
- **contao-manual-content**: Use when asked how to build pages or content in the Contao backend
- **contao-manual-features**: Use when asked about a Contao form or a Contao extension in the backend
- **contao-platform**: Use when the request names a Contao hook or Contao caching

### flatpickr

- **flatpickr-api**: Use when the request names flatpickr or a JS date picker
- **flatpickr-extend**: Use when the request names a flatpickr plugin or locale

### gotenberg

- **gotenberg-convert**: Use when converting a document or page to PDF with Gotenberg
- **gotenberg-operations**: Use when deploying or configuring Gotenberg
- **gotenberg-pdf**: Use when manipulating an existing PDF with Gotenberg

### octo-api

- **octo-availability**: Use when the request names OCTO or Ventrata availability, availabilityId, or calendar
- **octo-bookings**: Use when the request names OCTO or Ventrata bookings, reservations, or a booking uuid
- **octo-capabilities-commerce**: Use when the request names an octo/* commerce capability such as octo/pricing
- **octo-capabilities-fulfilment**: Use when the request names an octo/* fulfilment capability such as octo/redemption
- **octo-capabilities-platform**: Use when the request names an octo/* platform capability such as octo/webhooks
- **octo-gocity**: Use when the request names Go City, gocity, or compares Ventrata with Go City
- **octo-products**: Use when the request names OCTO or Ventrata products, options, units, or availabilityType
- **octo-protocol**: Use when the request names OCTO, Ventrata, Octo-Capabilities, Octo-Env, or an octo/* capability

### panther

- **panther-setup**: Use when configuring Panther or running it in CI
- **panther-testing**: Use when writing a Symfony Panther browser test

### playwright

- **playwright-debugging**: Use when a Playwright test fails unclearly or is flaky
- **playwright-library**: Use when automating a browser outside the test runner
- **playwright-runner**: Use when configuring a Playwright suite
- **playwright-tooling**: Use when the request names Playwright MCP or the Playwright CLI
- **playwright-writing**: Use when writing or fixing a Playwright test

### shadcn

- **shadcn-blocks**: Use when the request names a shadcn block or registry
- **shadcn-data**: Use when the request names a shadcn table, data table or chart
- **shadcn-feedback**: Use when showing state or confirming with shadcn/ui
- **shadcn-forms**: Use when building a form with shadcn/ui
- **shadcn-layout**: Use when structuring a page with shadcn/ui
- **shadcn-navigation**: Use when building navigation or a command palette with shadcn/ui
- **shadcn-setup**: Use when the request names shadcn setup, init or components.json
- **shadcn-theming**: Use when the request names shadcn theming, colors or dark mode

### shadcn-vue

- **shadcn-vue-blocks**: Use when the request names a shadcn-vue block or registry
- **shadcn-vue-data**: Use when the request names a shadcn-vue table, data table or chart
- **shadcn-vue-feedback**: Use when showing state or confirming with shadcn-vue
- **shadcn-vue-forms**: Use when building a form with shadcn-vue
- **shadcn-vue-layout**: Use when structuring a page with shadcn-vue
- **shadcn-vue-navigation**: Use when building navigation or a command palette with shadcn-vue
- **shadcn-vue-setup**: Use when the request names shadcn-vue setup, init or components.json
- **shadcn-vue-theming**: Use when the request names shadcn-vue theming, dark mode or its CSS variables

- **sw-merchant-spatial**: Use when the request names Shopware Spatial, 3D products or AR
- **sw-merchant-tutorials**: Use when the request asks how to accomplish a concrete task in the Shopware admin

### shopware-migration

- **sw-upgrade**: Use when upgrading a Shopware plugin to a newer version

### shopware-quality

- **sw-analysis**: Use when configuring or fixing Shopware static analysis

- **sw-release**: Use when preparing a Shopware plugin release

### shopware-storefront

- **sw-controller**: Use when building a Shopware Storefront controller or page
- **sw-features**: Use when the request names a Shopware listing filter or SEO URL

### zone-claude-forge

- **zcf-component-authoring**: Use when writing an agents/*.md, a commands/*.md, or a UserPromptSubmit or PostToolUse hook

- **zcf-source-distillation**: Use when distilling a docs site or openapi.yaml into SKILL.md reference files
